ruleDefinitions.name: Execute Files with Msdeploy.exe
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects file execution using the msdeploy.exe lolbin

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*verb\\:sync.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-source\\:RunCommand.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-dest\\:runCommand.*")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\msdeploy\\\.exe$"))
